purpose: Define a broad, extensible recognition catalog and annotation targets before benchmarking or training.

objectDetection.idPolicy: Canonical IDs are zero-based and fixed. Any format-specific export IDs must have an explicit mapping back to these canonical IDs. Append new classes in a later version; never silently reorder IDs.

classes.name: cup_body
classes.definition: The visible body of a single-use beverage cup, independently of its material.
exclude: cup lids
straws
reusable mugs
drinking glasses
bowls
classes.legacyMappingRequirement: Use paper_cup only when the body is reliably identified as paper-based; otherwise use unknown.

classes.name: cup_lid
classes.definition: A removable beverage cup lid, attached or detached, with a separately identifiable visible boundary.
exclude: bottle caps
jar lids
food-container lids
an inferred lid hidden behind an object
classes.legacyMappingRequirement: Keep the existing check-material behavior until a reviewed, material-specific lid rule is added.

classes.name: straw
classes.definition: A visibly identifiable drinking straw; the class does not establish material or disposability.
include: paper, plastic or reusable straws when identifiable
exclude: stirrers
pens
cables
chopsticks
unidentifiable thin lines
classes.legacyMappingRequirement: Keep check-material behavior; never copy the cup body's disposal rule.

classes.name: bottle
classes.definition: An identifiable beverage bottle body; label a separately identifiable visible cap as bottle_cap.
exclude: jars
cups
aerosols
household-product bottles pending a separate catalog extension
unidentifiable containers
classes.legacyMappingRequirement: Use plastic_bottle only when reliably identified as a disposable plastic beverage bottle. Glass and reusable bottles do not inherit that rule.

classes.name: beverage_can
classes.definition: An identifiable beverage can, including crushed cans when enough visual evidence remains.
exclude: aerosol cans
food tins
composite paper cans
unidentifiable crushed metal
classes.legacyMappingRequirement: Use metal_can only for a reliably identified metal beverage can, with the applicable preparation instruction.

classes.name: paper_sheet
classes.definition: A visible loose sheet or clearly identifiable piece of paper.
exclude: cardboard boxes or pieces
napkins and tissues
paper towels

classes.legacyMappingRequirement: Apply the reviewed paper rule only when the material and applicable preparation/contamination conditions are supported; otherwise use unknown.

classes.name: food_scraps
classes.definition: Visible unwrapped food scraps, separately identifiable from packaging.
exclude: closed food packaging

classes.legacyMappingRequirement: Use the reviewed public-space food rule and its Green Bin availability condition.

classes.name: waste_bin
classes.definition: A visible physical waste receptacle. Appearance does not establish City ownership, inventory identity, location or condition.
exclude: loose garbage bags

classes.legacyMappingRequirement: Route to bin inspection. A registered, approved in-service asset and reporting checks are still required for automatic reporting.

classes.name: normal
classes.definition: The relevant opening/contents are sufficiently visible, with no visible overflow and no clear near-opening fullness.

classes.name: full_without_overflow
classes.definition: Visible contents reach near the opening but remain inside it; there is no visible waste protruding from or spilling out of that opening.

classes.name: overflowing
classes.definition: Waste visibly protrudes from, or spills out of, an identifiable opening of this bin.

binCondition.unverifiablePolicy: Use a null condition label plus a review/quality reason when the image does not support a condition. Do not force such crops into normal or full_without_overflow, and do not export null as a fourth supervised class.
negativeEvidence: nearby litter without a visible connection to this opening
a closed lid with hidden contents
a street address or GPS location
binCondition.cropPolicy: One identified bin per condition crop, retaining enough opening and adjacent context to attribute any visible spillage. Multiple bins are inspected separately.

annotationAttributes.materialPolicy: Record a material other than unknown only with a recorded verifiable basis. Material metadata is annotation truth, not an inference head; the object detector does not automatically produce it at runtime.
annotationAttributes.reviewPolicy: Attributes belong in dataset metadata/sidecars. A plain YOLO label text file contains class and box only; preserve sidecars when exporting.

boxPolicy.trainingAnnotationSpace: Tight axis-aligned boxes around visible object extent in the source image; clip boxes to image boundaries.
boxPolicy.appCoordinateSpace: The future adapter returns normalized x,y,width,height in the exact camera crop visible to the user.
boxPolicy.parts: Box separately identifiable components independently, including detached lids/caps and straws. Assign one canonical label per physical part. Bounding boxes may overlap for genuinely separate parts; never invent invisible extents.
boxPolicy.ambiguity: Do not guess between overlapping or confusing subtypes. Confirmed non-target scenes may be background negatives. Possible supported targets with unresolved identity need review and exclusion from supervised exports until resolved; never draw an unknown-class box.
boxPolicy.completeness: Annotate every independently identifiable supported instance. An unresolved possible target must not silently become background in a plain YOLO export; exclude the image unless an explicitly supported ignore-region pipeline handles it.
boxPolicy.smallParts: Label a straw or other small part only if independently identifiable. Record too-small cases and preserve source resolution for later input-size evaluation.

sceneRouting.item: A clearly presented foreground item receives component guidance; lack of GPS does not block sorting.
sceneRouting.bin: A stable bin view without a competing user-presented foreground item routes to condition assessment. Contents inside the bin are not automatically treated as held sorting items.
sceneRouting.mixedOrAmbiguous: Keep automatic scene selection. Prioritize a clearly presented item; otherwise show uncertainty and do not automatically report while target selection is ambiguous.
sceneRouting.unrelated: No supported target produces no fabricated object, guidance or report.
sceneRouting.presentationDomains: Screen/print rephotographs are tagged separately. Intentional projector evaluations belong to isolated demo scope, not public incidents. Domain metadata alone is not proof that a runtime image is physical.

requires: fresh unambiguous GPS match or explicit bin selection
successful evidence/database persistence before showing Reported
neverInfer: a bin's identity or ownership from appearance
physical presence from an image alone
a successful report from a client prediction
independent corroboration from multiple sessions alone

initialScopeExclusions: claims to recognize every possible item
chemical composition or invisible contents from appearance
unreviewed disposal instructions for new or special-guidance labels
automatic reporting of generic litter or illegal dumping

legacyCompatibility.notes: Original canonical IDs 0-7 are retained; new labels append at 8-39. Existing Gemini/rule enums are unchanged. Most added labels have no reviewed app rule yet and must remain check/unknown until a deliberate adapter and rule review are completed.
legacyCompatibility.integrationIssueToResolveLater: The current normalized box parser requires width and height >= 0.01. Thin but valid straw boxes may violate that bound. Retain honest annotations and evaluate/adjust the adapter or parser during integration; do not pad training boxes to satisfy the current parser.

sourceReferences.title: Toronto Recycling Right in Public Spaces

catalogPolicy.activation: A label is planned, not trained support. Each exported model manifest must declare exactly which canonical classes have passed held-out validation.
catalogPolicy.hierarchy: Use families to organize labels, data collection and coverage reporting. Family membership does not give a closed-set detector new zero-shot recognition abilities.
catalogPolicy.singlePartRule: Each physical part receives one label, using the most specific supported definition. Distinct body/lid/straw instances may have overlapping boxes.
catalogPolicy.unknownRoute: Reject unsupported, ambiguous or out-of-distribution inputs instead of choosing the nearest trained class. Provide an honest initial uncertainty response and offer an explicit item lookup or optional broader model clarification.
catalogPolicy.unknownRuleGate: A broader model may suggest an item name; disposal still requires a reviewed rule and sufficient material/context evidence. A model suggestion must not invent a rule or trigger a report.
catalogPolicy.latency: The two-second first-feedback deadline remains. Broader lookup/clarification may take longer and must not be misrepresented as instant verified recognition.
catalogPolicy.promotion: Promote new labels after defining boundaries, collecting labeled examples and hard negatives, reviewing the applicable disposal rule, validating the model/export and updating its coverage manifest.

specialGuidancePolicy.detectionMeaning: Recognize the visible object category only. Do not infer chemistry, charge, pressure, damage, contamination or invisible contents.
specialGuidancePolicy.disposal: Require a reviewed item-specific lookup and any necessary user clarification. None of these newly planned labels automatically maps to ordinary garbage, recycling or organics.
